classification: active-path audit and RED contract freeze

verified_objective_contract.material_gradient: direct sum of exact per-step discrete VJPs

dispatch_to_visco_fwi.expected_contract: MODE=1 with L>0 dispatches the viscoelastic SH FWI driver
dispatch_to_visco_fwi.reason: The top-level physics dispatch is correctly viscoelastic.

base_objective_physics.expected_contract: The base objective uses the same viscoelastic forward physics as the trial objective
base_objective_physics.observed_contract: The viscoelastic FWI driver obtains L2t[1] from elastic grad_obj_sh
base_objective_physics.reason: Base and trial objectives are evaluated with different physics.

base_gradient_entry.expected_contract: The active base gradient enters the locked C7 exact viscoelastic material-gradient chain
base_gradient_entry.observed_contract: The active entry is the elastic grad_obj_sh result followed by legacy ass_gradSH_visc
base_gradient_entry.reason: The locked C7 trajectory and reverse-time material driver are unreachable from the active entry.

base_forward_operator.expected_contract: The base forward uses sh_visc and captures the C7a observable trajectory
base_forward_operator.observed_contract: The active base-gradient callee uses elastic sh in mode 0
base_forward_operator.reason: Attenuation and GSLS memory evolution are absent from the active base forward.

base_adjoint_operator.expected_contract: The active adjoint uses the locked exact C5/C7 reverse-time operator
base_adjoint_operator.observed_contract: The active base-gradient callee uses elastic sh in mode 1
base_adjoint_operator.reason: The exact viscoelastic state transpose and material VJPs are not called.

exact_c7_gradient_reachable.expected_contract: The active path calls visco_sh_reverse_time_adjoint_material with C7a observables and chronological receiver cotangents
exact_c7_gradient_reachable.observed_contract: No active FWI, gradient, or trial source calls the locked C7 reverse-time material driver
exact_c7_gradient_reachable.reason: The independently verified exact material gradient remains disconnected.

trial_model_update.expected_contract: Trial and accepted models update the chosen physical primary, rho, and Q parameters
trial_model_update.observed_contract: Only u and rho are updated; ts, tsnp1, waveconv_ts, Q bounds, and INV_QS_ITER are not used by an update
trial_model_update.reason: Attenuation trial and accepted-model updates are disconnected.

trial_objective_physics.expected_contract: L>0 trial objectives propagate with viscoelastic SH physics
trial_objective_physics.observed_contract: obj_sh selects sh_visc in mode 2 when L is nonzero
trial_objective_physics.reason: The trial propagator itself is viscoelastic, although its material preparation is incomplete.

trial_material_halo_exchange.expected_contract: Viscoelastic trials exchange primary, rho, and tau through matcopy_SH before derived coefficients
trial_material_halo_exchange.observed_contract: obj_sh exchanges only rho and u; ptaus halos are not refreshed by the viscoelastic material graph
trial_material_halo_exchange.reason: Trial material preparation differs from the locked C6/C7 forward graph.

owned_q_preserved.expected_contract: Owned physical Q remains available separately from derived cell-centred and staggered tau
owned_q_preserved.observed_contract: File-level Q is immediately converted into matSH.ptaus; matSH has no owned physical-Q array
owned_q_preserved.reason: The physical parameter required by the locked tau-to-Q VJP is not retained.

evidence.expression: q_to_tau is applied only while loading .qs into ptaus

q_to_tau_mapping.expected_contract: Every base, trial, and accepted physical-Q model derives tau through the selected mapping
q_to_tau_mapping.observed_contract: The mapping is correct at initial read but no physical Q survives for later trial or accepted updates
q_to_tau_mapping.reason: Initial conversion exists, but the end-to-end active parameter graph is incomplete.

evidence.expression: base calls grad_obj_sh; ass_gradSH_visc produces only u/rho; PCG helpers ignore waveconv_ts

q_gradient_reaches_optimizer.expected_contract: The locked physical-Q gradient enters the selected optimizer as a third parameter class
q_gradient_reaches_optimizer.observed_contract: The base path does not create physical bar_Q; legacy waveconv_ts is not populated by the active gradient and PCG storage/extraction omits it
q_gradient_reaches_optimizer.reason: Attenuation-gradient connectivity is absent despite three-class allocations.

evidence.expression: ts and tsnp1 are parameters only; Q limits and INV_QS_ITER are declared but unused

q_trial_update.expected_contract: Line search and accepted updates modify owned physical Q subject to the selected bounds and mapping
q_trial_update.observed_contract: Neither Q nor tau is modified
q_trial_update.reason: There is no active attenuation inversion update.

evidence.expression: descent negates PCG inputs; calc_mat_change_test_SH_visc later subtracts waveconv; LBFGS/PCG treat the third class inconsistently

optimizer_sign_contract.expected_contract: Each active array has one documented raw-gradient or descent-direction meaning before m_new = m - alpha*g
optimizer_sign_contract.observed_contract: u/rho ultimately feed subtractive updates, but method-specific sign transformations differ and Q has no complete path
optimizer_sign_contract.reason: The C7 raw-gradient sign must be locked at the optimizer boundary before C8-b integration.

evidence.expression: L2t[1] from grad_obj_sh while L2t[2]/L2t[3] come from obj_sh

zero_step_same_physics.expected_contract: J_base and J_trial(alpha=0) use identical viscoelastic physics and agree to relative 1e-12
zero_step_same_physics.observed_contract: The base uses elastic sh while L>0 trials use sh_visc
zero_step_same_physics.reason: For nontrivial attenuation, structural zero-step equality is impossible.

evidence.expression: legacy sh_visc(mode 0/1); no visco_sh_reverse_time_adjoint_material; waveconv_ts_shot is not added to waveconv_ts

legacy_grad_obj_sh_visc_is_exact_c7.expected_contract: Any replacement gradient entry is mathematically equivalent to the locked C7 chain
legacy_grad_obj_sh_visc_is_exact_c7.observed_contract: The unused legacy routine runs nominal sh_visc mode 1 and omits the locked exact reverse/material driver and attenuation shot summation
legacy_grad_obj_sh_visc_is_exact_c7.reason: Replacing grad_obj_sh by grad_obj_sh_visc alone would not close C8.

evidence.expression: MODE==1 and INVMAT1==1 only; elastic Vs/rho assembly with DT/DTINV formulas

elastic_exact_assembler_reusable.expected_contract: The active viscoelastic path uses the locked C7 Vs/mu, rho, and Q material VJPs
elastic_exact_assembler_reusable.observed_contract: assemble_gradSH_exact is an elastic INVMAT1=1 Vs/rho assembler with no GSLS-memory or Q contribution
elastic_exact_assembler_reusable.reason: It is not a viscoelastic C7 replacement.

evidence.expression: production elastic and finite-Q viscoelastic receiver traces are compared dynamically

dynamic_elastic_visco_difference.expected_contract: Nontrivial attenuation materially changes the production receiver data
dynamic_elastic_visco_difference.observed_contract: The existing production-kernel rheology regression demonstrates finite-Q traces distinct from elastic and converging toward elastic as Q increases
dynamic_elastic_visco_difference.reason: The active base/trial call-graph split is numerical, not merely nominal.
